arxiv-2011-08580.title: On the partial uniform ellipticity and complete conformal metrics with prescribed curvature functions on manifolds with boundary Thanks: The author was supported by NSFC Grant 11801587.
arxiv-2011-08580.creator: Rirong Yuan
arxiv-2011-08580.description: Abstract . We consider the problem of finding complete conformal metrics with prescribed curvature functions of the Einstein tensor and of more general modified Schouten tensors. To achieve this, we reveal an algebraic structure of a wide class of fully nonlinear equations. Our method is appropriate and delicate as shown by a topological obstruction.

arxiv-2105-03994.title: Dispatcher: A Message-Passing Approach To Language Modelling.
arxiv-2105-03994.creator: Alberto Cetoli
arxiv-2105-03994.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alberto Cetoli. This paper proposes a message-passing mechanism to address language modelling. A new layer type is introduced that aims to substitute self-attention for unidirectional sequence generation tasks. The system is shown to be competitive with existing methods: Given N N tokens, the computational complexity is 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ​ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\,\mathrm{log}N) and the memory complexity is 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) under reasonable assumptions.

arxiv-2310-18684.title: Thermalization and hydrodynamics in an interacting integrable system: the case of hard rods
arxiv-2310-18684.creator: Sahil Kumar Singh 1, Abhishek Dhar 1, Herbert Spohn 2,3 and Anupam Kundu 1
arxiv-2310-18684.description: Abstract We consider the relaxation of an initial non-equilibrium state in a one-dimensional fluid of hard rods. Since it is an interacting integrable system, we expect it to reach the Generalized Gibbs Ensemble (GGE) at long times for generic initial conditions.

arxiv-2502-07979.title: Joint Modelling Histology and Molecular Markers for Cancer Classification Journal: Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2502-07979.creator: Xiaofei Wang, Hanyu Liu, Yupei Zhang, Boyang Zhao, Hao Duan, Wanming Hu, Yonggao Mou, Stephen Price, Chao Li
arxiv-2502-07979.description: Abstract Cancers are characterized by remarkable heterogeneity and diverse prognosis. Accurate cancer classification is essential for patient stratification and clinical decision-making. Although digital pathology has been advancing cancer diagnosis and prognosis, the paradigm in cancer pathology has shifted from purely relying on histology features to incorporating molecular markers.

arxiv-2507-02520.title: Exploring black hole shadows in axisymmetric spacetimes with coordinate-independent methods and neural networks
arxiv-2507-02520.creator: Temurbek Mirzaev, Bobomurat Ahmedov, Cosimo Bambi
arxiv-2507-02520.description: Abstract The study of black hole shadows provides a powerful tool for testing the predictions of general relativity and exploring deviations from the standard Kerr metric in the strong gravitational field regime. Here, we investigate the shadow properties of axisymmetric gravitational compact objects using a coordinate-independent formalism.

arxiv-2512-20812.title: Semantic Deception: When Reasoning Models Can’t Compute an Addition
arxiv-2512-20812.creator: Nathaniël de Leeuw, Marceau Nahon, Mathis Reymond, Raja Chatila, Mehdi Khamassi
arxiv-2512-20812.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nathaniël de Leeuw, Marceau Nahon, Mathis Reymond, Raja Chatila, Mehdi Khamassi. Large language models (LLMs) - systems based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) designed for text generation - are increasingly used in situations where human values are at stake, such as decision-making tasks that involve reasoning when performed by humans. In this article, we investigate the so-called reasoning capabilities of LLMs over novel symbolic representations by introducing an experimental framework that tests their ability to process and manipulate unfamiliar symbols.

arxiv-2601-13093.title: Quasi-maximal ideals and ring extensions
arxiv-2601-13093.creator: Gabriel Picavet* and Martine Picavet-L’Hermitte
arxiv-2601-13093.description: Abstract . Alan and al. defined and studied quasi-maximal ideals. We add a comprehensive characterization of these ideals, introducing submaximal ideals. The conductor of a finite minimal extension R ⊂ S R\subset S is quasi-maximal in S S . This allows us to give a new characterization of these extensions.

pmc-10543360.title: Hsa_circ_0119412 is a tumor promoter in hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting miR-526b-5p to upregulate STMN1
pmc-10543360.creator: Song Wu, Tao Tang, Hongchi Zhou, Jing Huang, Xiaoliang Kang, Junli Zhang
pmc-10543360.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is always deemed a deadly malignancy worldwide. Non-coding RNAs, including circRNAs, are becoming more widely recognized as essential regulators of the malignant development of HCC. Thus, we elaborated the regulating role of hsa_circ_0119412 in HCC advancement. The qRT-PCR was done to estimate the expressions of hsa_circ_0119412, miR-526b-5p, and Stathmin 1 (STMN1) in HCC (clinical samples and cell lines), and immunoblotting was used to detect STMN1 protein level in HCC cell lines.

pmc-10648070.title: Hepatoprotective Effect of Medicine Food Homology Flower Saffron against CCl4-Induced Liver Fibrosis in Mice via the Akt/HIF-1α/VEGF Signaling Pathway
pmc-10648070.creator: Huajuan Jiang, Xulong Huang, Jiaxin Wang, Yongfeng Zhou, Chaoxiang Ren, Tao Zhou, Jin Pei, Ryszard Amarowicz, Manoj Kumar
pmc-10648070.description: Liver fibrosis refers to a complex inflammatory response caused by multiple factors, which is a known cause of liver cirrhosis and even liver cancer. As a valuable medicine food homology herb, saffron has been widely used in the world. Saffron is commonly used in liver-related diseases and has rich therapeutic and health benefits.

pmc-10850316.title: Opioid use disorder: current trends and potential treatments
pmc-10850316.creator: Yu Kyung Lee, Mark S. Gold, Kenneth Blum, Panayotis K. Thanos, Colin Hanna, Brian S. Fuehrlein
pmc-10850316.description: Opioid use disorder (OUD) is a major public health threat, contributing to morbidity and mortality from addiction, overdose, and related medical conditions. Despite our increasing knowledge about the pathophysiology and existing medical treatments of OUD, it has remained a relapsing and remitting disorder for decades, with rising deaths from overdoses, rather than declining.

pmc-11655569.title: Can surface landmarks help us identify the gibson interval during surgical hip dislocation: a study of 617 hips
pmc-11655569.creator: Veerle Franken, Stefan Blümel, Joseph M. Schwab, Moritz Tannast
pmc-11655569.description: IntroductionThe Gibson approach, used in hip-preserving surgery, is intermuscular and develops the space anteriorly to the gluteus maximus. Reliable anatomical landmarks for the development of this interval do not exist, but the interval is marked by perforating vessels (PV) of the inferior gluteal artery.

pmc-11713010.title: Understanding Willingness to Share SBEDOH Information: Cultural Sensitivity and Community Engagement in ADRD Research
pmc-11713010.creator: Larry D. Adams, Farid Rajabli, Mary E Douglas, Jose Javier Sanchez, Rhoda Moise, Michael L. Cuccaro, Margaret A Pericak‐Vance, Azizi A Seixas
pmc-11713010.description: BackgroundUnderstanding social, behavioral, and environmental determinants of health (SBEDOH) are key in identifying modifiable risk factors for Alzheimer’s Disease and related Dementias (ADRD), particularly the disproportionate burden seen in minorities. However, a lack of standardized SBEDOH methods exists with current methods limited in scope and cultural sensitivity (i.e. can be used across different settings and populations and devoid of stigma).

pmc-12653542.title: Multicenter European Data of Anatomical Parameters of the Anterior Eye Segment Measured with an Optical Biometer
pmc-12653542.creator: Ava Niknahad, Hyeck-Soo Son, Gerd U. Auffarth, Louise Blöck, Giacomo Savini, Catarina P. Coutinho, Joaquín Fernández, Grzegorz Łabuz
pmc-12653542.description: Background/Objectives: Normative values of ocular parameters can be influenced by a variety of factors. This study evaluates the relationship of axial length (AL), anterior and posterior corneal curvature, anterior chamber, and corneal thickness variables with age, spherical equivalent (SE), and gender. Methods: A retrospective cohort study at three hospitals identified patients from June 2019 to July 2022.

pmc-12675292.title: Population-specific polygenic risk scores for people of Han Chinese ancestry
pmc-12675292.creator: Hung-Hsin Chen, Chien-Hsiun Chen, Ming-Chih Hou, Yun-Ching Fu, Ling-Hui Li, Che-Yu Chou, Erh-Chan Yeh, Ming-Fang Tsai, Chun-houh Chen, Hsin-Chou Yang, Yen-Tsung Huang, Yi-Min Liu, Chun-yu Wei, Jen-Ping Su, Wan-Jia Lin, Elin H. F. Wang, Chi-Lu Chiang, Jeng-Kai Jiang, I-Hui Lee, Kung-Hao Liang, Wei-Sh
pmc-12675292.description: Predicting complex disease risks on the basis of individual genomic profiles is an advancing field in human genetics1,2. However, most genetic studies have focused on populations of European ancestry, creating a global imbalance in precision medicine and underscoring the need for genomic research in non-European groups3,4.

pmc-13218090.title: Sino-Canadian Healthy Life Trajectories Initiative in China: an economic evaluation protocol
pmc-13218090.creator: Yulai Zhou, Hua Zhou, He-Feng Huang, William D Fraser, Jianxia Fan, Jean-Patrice Baillargeon, Thomas G Poder, Bin Wu
pmc-13218090.description: IntroductionChildhood overweight and obesity (OWO) in China, especially in urban areas, has become a significant public health challenge. Recent studies indicate a high prevalence of OWO in both children and adults, exacerbated by urbanisation and economic development. This trend poses a threat to health outcomes, including neurocognitive functioning, socio-emotional development and risk of chronic conditions.
